name: calendar-lag-forward
why: Calendar-day lag across a weekend and a holiday (Mon 8 Mar 2027), beside the same lag in working days. Indices: 0-4 = Mon 1-Fri 5 Mar, Mon 8 is a holiday, 5-8 = Tue 9-Fri 12, 9 = Mon 15, 10 = Tue 16. A finish instant is the start of the calendar day after the last working day; a start instant is the start of the first day.

a.why: LF = min(PF 11, c: LS 9 - 4 = 5, b (calendar FS): b's latest start instant Mon 15 Mar minus 4 days = Thu 11 Mar; the last finish whose instant is on or before Thu 11 is index 7 (finishing Wed 10) = 7, d (calendar SS): LS_d 10 = Tue 16, minus 2 = Sun 14, last start on or before = index 8, + D_a 5 = 13) = 5. FF = min(6 - 6, 9 - 9, 2 - 2) = 0.

b.why: a ends Fri 5 Mar, so its finish instant is Sat 6 Mar; + 4 calendar days = Wed 10 Mar (Sat, Sun, the Monday holiday and Tuesday pass) = index 6. LF = PF 11.

c.why: Working lag: F_a 5 + 4 = 9 = Mon 15 Mar; the holiday is not a working day, so 4 working days reach further than 4 calendar days.

d.why: Calendar SS+2: a starts Mon 1 Mar, + 2 days = Wed 3 Mar = index 2. LF 11, LS 10.
